name: io.github.Ustay-coder/verdict
title: Verdict
description: Score text, files and pages against a rubric with decision models; compare models on your cases.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key for Jev, the default decision model, when judging runs in this process.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare account for Clef and Clef-flash on Workers AI.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare token (Workers AI: Read) for Clef and Clef-flash.

environmentVariables.name: VERDICT_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder to keep rubrics and evaluations in between runs. Without it they are kept in memory.

environmentVariables.name: VERDICT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of a Verdict API to use instead of judging in this process.
